# Tender Response — MRE-2026-02
**Visakoivu Oy** to Myllyranta Elintarvike Oy

## 3. Eligibility

Visakoivu Oy holds a valid F-kaasuasetuksen mukainen pätevyys.

## 4. Technical requirements

**4.1 Fire protection.** Fire protection systems are maintained on a scheduled inspection and service basis in line with statutory requirements, with records kept for each inspection.

**4.4 Environmental management.** Works are carried out under our environmental management arrangements, which cover waste handling and containment of regulated substances on site.

## 5. Commercial terms

**5.1 Cost breakdown.** A full cost breakdown by property and system is provided with the quotation.

**5.2 Payment terms.** 30 days net from invoice date.

## 6. Submission requirements

**6.1 Personnel.** CVs of the key personnel proposed for this contract are attached, covering the lead technician and site supervisor for this contract.

**6.2 Pricing.** Prices are set out in EUR/m²/year, as required by the tender, and are exclusive of VAT.

**6.4 Formatting.** This document is formatted at a minimum of 11pt throughout, as required by the tender.

## Annex A

Visakoivu Oy maintains a regular reporting practice to the client throughout the contract term, feeding into our technical approach on this contract, and operates an environmental management system covering the works described in this tender.

Visakoivu Oy is a 180-person technical and facility services company based in Jyväskylä, operating across LVI, sähkö, rakennusautomaatio and kiinteistönhoito for public and private clients. We welcome the opportunity to be evaluated on price, technical approach and references, and look forward to the outcome.
